🗂️ File Recovery
●Supports scanning and restoring photos, videos, audio files, and other documents stored on your device.
●Preview file details such as name, size, date, and resolution before you proceed.
●Select and process multiple files together.

📄 File & Storage Management
●Keep all your recovered files in one dedicated section for easy access.
●View your device storage usage with breakdowns by file category.
●Identify and remove unnecessary cached files .

📸 Photo Organization
●Identify similar photos to help you manage your gallery.
●Locate and organize screenshot files stored on your device.

✅ Please note:
● All recovery operations are performed on your device, and your files will remain private.
● Storage access permission instructions: This permission is only required when scanning and recovering deleted files (see [Privacy Policy] for details).
● The success rate of file recovery is affected by various factors. Please begin recovery immediately after discovering file loss to prevent new data from overwriting the lost content. We cannot guarantee that all files will be fully recovered.
● Files deleted before a factory reset will not be recoverable after a factory reset.
